profile.headline: Software Engineer II at BlackRock
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer at BlackRock, I focus on building modern, accessible, and user-centered digital experiences that help improve the way technology is developed and used across the organization. Since joining BlackRock in 2021, I have continued to grow my expertise in frontend engineering, user experience, accessibility, and Al-enabled development.
I hold a background in User Experience Engineering and Information Technology from the University of California, Santa Cruz, where I developed a strong foundation in designing intuitive interfaces, solving complex technical challenges, and delivering scalable software solutions.
Today, I am part of BlackRock's Al Engineering organization, where I help develop tools, platforms, and experiences that improve developer productivity and enable teams to build high-quality software more efficiently. My work spans frontend architecture, design systems, developer tooling, Al-powered workflows, and user experience enhancements.
Recent projects have included modernizing component development workflows, improving developer experience platforms, advancing Al-assisted engineering capabilities, and building scalable solutions that support collaboration, accessibility, and innovation across engineering teams.
Having started my journey at BlackRock as a summer intern, I'm proud of the opportunity to grow with the firm and contribute to initiatives that help shape the future of software engineering and technology innavation.

- Used Angular to design a product that would help increase efficiency within our clients workflow

Consulted and upskilled clients on partner’s products: SONOS, Apple, AT&T, Android

Managed exclusive partnership Google’s hardware

honors.title: Dean's Honors
honors.description: In accordance with the Santa Cruz Academic Senate regulations, students qualify for the Dean's Honors List for a given term when they have completed a minimum of 15 units of which 10 are units for a letter grade with a grade point average in the range required for University Honors at graduation for the current academic year (i.e. the top 15% of their academic group).
